name: ven-agency-support
description: Ven Agency WordPress support connector, legacy plugin, and Cloudflare Worker gateway.

scripts.wp:start: npm run local:setup && wp-env start && (wp-env run cli wp plugin deactivate ven-agency-support --quiet || true)
scripts.wp:verify: wp-env run cli wp eval 'if ( ! class_exists( "Ven_Support_Connector" ) ) { fwrite( STDERR, "Ven Support Connector is not loaded.\n" ); exit( 1 ); } echo "Ven Support Connector is loaded.\n";'
scripts.wp:verify-plugin: wp-env run cli wp plugin status ven-agency-support
scripts.lint: npm run connector:lint && npm run plugin:lint && node --check cloudflare/ven-support-task-gateway/src/index.js && node --check scripts/setup-local-env.mjs
scripts.worker:dev: npm run local:setup && cd cloudflare/ven-support-task-gateway && npx --yes wrangler@4.92.0 dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8796
